name: Six of Swords
keywords: getting out of a hard place

facts.ferryman: A ferryman with his back turned pushes a flat boat across the water with a long pole.
facts.passengers: In the boat, a hooded figure sits with head bowed, and a child is beside the figure.
facts.six-swords: Six swords stand upright at the front of the boat.
facts.far-shore: Trees can be seen on the shore opposite.
facts.water-contrast: The water to the left of the boat is calm, and waves rise at the lower right.
facts.pale-sky: The sky is a pale gray.

glosses.passengers: A person leaving quietly, carrying sorrow.
glosses.water-contrast: A move from rough water toward the calm side.

reversedGloss.blocked: Trying to move on, but circumstances tie the feet.
reversedGloss.internalized: The body has left, but the heart still stays in the old place.

misdescriptions.wrong: The boat is tossed by a storm.
